class SearchCriteria:
    """The filter a customer submits to the catalogue.

    An empty field does not filter. Each budget is optional, so the screen can
    send one end of the slider only.
    """

    keyword: str = ""
    category: str = ""
    style: str = ""
    budget_min: int | None = None
    budget_max: int | None = None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Refuse a budget range that cannot be answered."""
        if self.budget_min is not None and self.budget_min < 0:
            raise ValueError("Minimum budget must not be negative")
        if self.budget_max is not None and self.budget_max < 0:
            raise ValueError("Maximum budget must not be negative")
        if (
            self.budget_min is not None
            and self.budget_max is not None
            and self.budget_min > self.budget_max
        ):
            raise ValueError("Minimum budget must not exceed the maximum")

class Account:
    """A single platform account."""

    email: str
    display_name: str
    password_hash: str
    role: Role
    status: AccountStatus = AccountStatus.PENDING
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid4()))
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Normalise the values identity depends on."""
        self.email = self.email.strip().lower()
        self.display_name = self.display_name.strip()

    def check_password(self, raw: str) -> bool:
        """Return ``True`` when ``raw`` is this account's password."""
        return verify_password(raw, self.password_hash)

    def activate(self) -> None:
        """Move the account into the ACTIVE status."""
        self.status = AccountStatus.ACTIVE

    def suspend(self) -> None:
        """Move the account into the SUSPENDED status."""
        self.status = AccountStatus.SUSPENDED

    def can_login(self) -> bool:
        """Return ``True`` only while the account is ACTIVE."""
        return self.status is AccountStatus.ACTIVE

    def change_display_name(self, name: str) -> None:
        """Replace the display name with ``name``.

        Raises ``ValueError`` when the new name is blank; that guard is a
        programming error rather than a flow the API is expected to surface.
        """
        candidate = name.strip()
        if not candidate:
            raise ValueError("Display name must not be empty")
        self.display_name = candidate

def object_tags(data: bytes) -> list[str]:
    """Return up to ``LIMIT`` catalogue tags for ``data``, most confident first.

    An empty list means the model is absent, refused the bytes, or saw nothing
    it can name. The caller must treat that as "colour tags only".
    """
    reading = read(data)
    return [] if reading is None else reading.tags

def suggest_tags(data: bytes) -> TagSuggestion:
    """Read ``data`` as an image and describe it.

    Raises ``ValueError`` when the bytes are not an image Pillow can read.
    A photo the model reads as an animal, a person, a vehicle or a landscape is
    returned with ``subject="other"`` and no tags at all: half a tag list is
    worse than a clear refusal, because the tags would drive a search.
    """
    try:
        with Image.open(BytesIO(data)) as image:
            image.load()
            width, height = image.size
            small = image.convert("RGB").resize(ANALYSIS_SIZE)
            palette = _palette(small)
            stats = _stats(small)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("The photo could not be read as an image") from exc
    reading = read_objects(data)
    subject = reading.subject if reading is not None else "room"
    objects = reading.tags if reading is not None else []
    return TagSuggestion(
        palette=palette,
        tags=[] if subject == "other" else _merge(objects, _tags(stats)),
        width=width,
        height=height,
        subject=subject,
        objects=[] if subject == "other" else objects,
    )

def _palette(image: Image.Image) -> list[PaletteEntry]:
    quantized = image.quantize(colors=PALETTE_SIZE, method=Image.Quantize.MEDIANCUT)
    table = quantized.getpalette() or []
    counts = quantized.getcolors() or []
    total = sum(count for count, _ in counts) or 1
    entries: list[PaletteEntry] = []
    for count, index in sorted(counts, reverse=True):
        base = index * 3
        colour = tuple(table[base : base + 3])
        entries.append(
            PaletteEntry(
                hex="#%02x%02x%02x" % colour,
                percent=round(100 * count / total, 1),
            )
        )
    return entries

def _stats(image: Image.Image) -> dict[str, float]:
    mean = ImageStat.Stat(image)
    brightness = sum(mean.mean) / 3
    contrast = sum(mean.stddev) / 3
    saturation = ImageStat.Stat(image.convert("HSV")).mean[1]
    grey = image.convert("L")
    edge = ImageStat.Stat(grey.filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES)).mean[0]
    return {
        "brightness": brightness,
        "contrast": contrast,
        "saturation": saturation,
        "edge": edge,
    }

async def store_upload(
    actor: CurrentAccountDep,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
) -> StoredImagePublic:
    """Keep a designer's photo so the project can show it later.

    The file is checked the same way as the tag reader: Pillow decodes it, so a
    renamed text file is refused. The name is random, so two designers can both
    upload ``kitchen.jpg`` without meeting.
    """
    data = await _read_photo(file)

    try:
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as probe:
            probe.verify()
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as probe:
            width, height = probe.size
    except Exception as exc:  # Pillow raises several unrelated types
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=http_status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail="That file is not an image",
        ) from exc

    declared = (file.content_type or "").lower()
    name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}{EXTENSIONS.get(declared, '.jpg')}"
    UPLOAD_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (UPLOAD_ROOT / name).write_bytes(data)

    return StoredImagePublic(url=f"/uploads/{name}", width=width, height=height)

    file: UploadFile = File(...),
) -> TagSuggestionPublic:
    """Describe an uploaded photo. Any signed-in account may call this.

    The bytes are checked by Pillow, not by the declared type alone: a renamed
    text file is refused with 422.
